subject: withProgress and multiple levels of reactive data - how to access the same progress bar?

messages.author: c1629c4c1cffcc0e
messages.subject: withProgress and multiple levels of reactive data - how to access the same progress bar?
parts:
Eek, I think that actually posted this in the shinyapps.io group.  So my apologies for that.

Anyways, we have about 4 levels of reactivity for each of our data tables or plots -- raw data -> filtered data -> grouped data -> formatted data.  This makes it really easy for us to use the same grouped data in multiple different formats without having to reprocess all of the data each time a user makes a change to the settings.

But the problem is, we either show progress on only one reactive expression, or we show 4 times the progress bars.  I would like to consolidate this into one single progress bar each time one of the "formatted data" reactive data is updated, and allow all of the sub-reactive data to update that progress bar as they provide their data.

Hopefully that makes sense.

I've tried the examples using Progress and withProgress, but we need to be using multiple reactive data to be as flexible with the processing as we can get for multiple uses, instead of a whole bunch of single reactive with multiple functions.

Has anyone done anything like this before?  Any suggestions?  Any help will be greatly appreciated.  Much thanks everyone.
~Laz Peterson
